args.title: checkout-api failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api was failing health checks (error rate 0.18) in all production regions after deploy of v2.3.1. Rolled back to v2.3.0 (most recent healthy production release) in us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Rollback status: rolled_out.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running `v2.3.1` in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: The deployment history showed `v2.3.0` was the most recent healthy production release (the only newer version, `v2.3.1`, was unhealthy).

3. **Rolled back**: Deployed `v2.3.0` to all production regions — status `rolled_out`.

4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident `INC-0001` for `checkout-api`, paging on-call, describing the health-check failure and the rollback to `v2.3.0`.
